English: Lowland Patch
A cluster of grass-rich lowland earth, roughly cleared for grazing. The first step toward establishing a foothold for your herds on the open steppe.
Open Steppe Range
Wide tracts of steppe are allocated and loosely managed for herd movement, granting greater freedom and more sustainable grazing.
Movable Pen
Portable wooden livestock pens, easily assembled and disassembled, allowing for efficient seasonal movement and grazing rotation.
Windshelter Hut
Simple, low-walled huts and windbreaks constructed from sod and brush, protecting animals and people from the fierce steppe winds.
Steppe Corral
A permanent corral of sturdy timber and stone, allowing for much larger herds and better animal management.
Nomad Grazing Yard
Expansive grazing yards with controlled rotation, improving herd health and allowing increased population and supply.
Windbreak Pavilion
Large tented pavilions and woven reed shelters, easily erected and moved as needed, maximize the safety and warmth of livestock and people.
Wide Pasture
Vast stretches of the best grassland reserved for the largest herds, with dedicated watchmen and patrols to guard against threats.
Steppe Herd Hall
A grand gathering hall for clan leaders and herders, serving as both a symbol of unity and a center for coordinating herd management and defense.
Great Steppe Pastures
An immense, expertly managed expanse of grazing land, the pride of the steppe—able to sustain legendary herds and the mightiest of nomadic hosts.
